roundsSummary: Round 1 (78f0acf1): fail — false 'du reports 0 blocks' claim, two Secret mounts called in-memory directories, one ungrammatical clause.
Round 2 (925cac4e): fail — `df -x` named as a one-filesystem flag, and an unsupported attribution of the 4.4 GiB discovery.

Round 4 (06e272bf): fail — the new memory paragraph named `/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current`, which this runtime does not have, carried a per-container claim its sandbox-wide counter cannot show, and misstated what live_operator_test.go asserts; review findings 1 and 3 were answered correctly.
